_README: Hand-made answer key. THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH — edit it when you disagree with it,
not the prompt. Seeded by Claude from the Lambeth notice and Zak's spec; review before trusting.
asserted  = values you are confident are correct. These are SCORED.
specialists values are ARRAYS and compared as sets, so order does not matter.
specialist_is_empty lists conditions that need no external specialist at all.
contested = conditions where two competent consultants would disagree. Reported, NOT scored.
Move an entry out of contested into asserted once you have decided the right answer.
flags.count       = exact number of consistency flags expected.
flags.must_include = flags that must be present; matched on type and a substring of detail.
A clean notice asserting count 0 is the FALSE-POSITIVE GUARD — the checker's whole value
depends on not crying wolf, so those entries matter more than the ones that find things.
Duplicates are NOT asked of the model. They are computed in app.detect_duplicates() by
comparing the verbatim source_quote of every pair of conditions, flagging above 0.90
similarity. That is deterministic and cannot drift; the model kept rationalising related
conditions into duplicates. flags.count therefore includes computed duplicates.

contested.18: gate: flips between before-use and blocks-any-commencement across runs. Decide which.
contested.19: specialist: Noise Management Plan is operational, but an acoustician often writes it.
contested.25: specialist: biodiverse green roofs — Landscape architect or Ecologist?
contested.32: specialist: water consumption calcs — in-house, or part of the sustainability package?
contested.11: gate_ambiguous: flagged ambiguous in some runs, not others. Decide.
contested.33: gate_ambiguous and specialist both drift. Decide.

24_3095_F-DECISION_NOTICE-1130692.pdf._note: Royal Borough of Greenwich, ref 24/3095/F. 27 pages, 42 conditions — the largest notice in the set, kept as the truncation regression test. Document-level facts are hand-verified; per-condition gates and specialists are deliberately NOT asserted here because they have not been checked against the notice by hand, and asserting model output as truth would make the key worthless.
